newsitem.title: GERMANY: ADM in move to buy German seed crusher Soya Mainz.
newsitem.headline: ADM in move to buy German seed crusher Soya Mainz.

text.p: German soybean crusher Soya Mainz GmbH & Co KG has been sold to a subsidiary of US Archer Daniels Midland and British Acatos & Hutcheson plc, a press release said.
The release, issued on behalf of Soya Mainz, said the move was still subject to cartel authority approval.
The German plant stood to gain access to its new owners' expertise, installations and trade connections in international oilseeds processing.
The plant, formerly owned by the Neuss-based Wilh. Werhahn group and Heidelberger Zement AG, last had annual sales of 390 million marks and employed 138.
Soya Mainz' nominal capacity has been put at 800,000 tonnes a year but actual output figures of meal, oil, protein concentrates and isolates were not available.

ADM already has a controlling stake in leading German processor Oelmuehle Hamburg AG (Oelag), which in 1996 crushed 3.10 million tonnes of soybeans, rapeseed and sunseed at facilities in Hamburg and Leer.
